reason: Six implemented GTM v2 tools list accounts/containers/workspaces/tags and create containers/tags; shared server also exposes 27 OAuth/SEO/Analytics tools.
exposure: All 33 tools are registered unconditionally. G_READONLY=true blocks mutating calls but does not hide tools. G_CONFIRM=true augments mutating tool schemas with optional confirm:boolean (description: Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled).); dispatch requires truthy confirmation. Auth tools are exempt; psi_run requires no OAuth. Default schemas below have G_CONFIRM unset.
limitations: Static literal registration extraction; no tools/list runtime or live Google API calls were executed.
GTM list handlers return a single page; tag object is intentionally unrestricted by upstream schema.
Schema defaults described in prose are preserved as descriptions, not invented JSON Schema defaults; handler defaults are recorded in behavior.
README claims broader functionality than GTM handlers: no GTM update/delete, trigger/variable, version/publish or workspace creation tools are registered.

tools.name: g_auth_status
tools.description: Show Google auth status: client_id/secret set, refresh token present and valid.
tools.behavior: Reports credential presence and attempts token refresh if a refresh token exists.

tools.name: g_set_credentials
tools.description: Save the Google OAuth app client_id and client_secret. Create a 'Desktop app' OAuth client at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials and enable the Search Console, Indexing, Analytics Admin/Data, Tag Manager APIs.
tools.behavior: Validates nonempty OAuth credentials and saves them to local configuration.

tools.name: g_authorize
tools.description: Open Google's consent screen and capture the authorization code via a local loopback server, then store the refresh token. Use on a machine with a browser. Returns the authorize_url to open if the browser does not open automatically.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for consent (default 180)

tools.behavior: Opens a browser and loopback callback server, exchanges the consent code and stores the refresh token; timeout defaults to 180 seconds with a 30-second minimum.

tools.name: g_set_code
tools.description: Manual fallback: paste an authorization code obtained by opening the authorize_url with a known redirect_uri (for headless machines).

redirect_uri.description: The exact redirect_uri used to get the code, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5000

tools.behavior: Exchanges a supplied authorization code and redirect URI and saves the refresh token.

tools.name: gsc_sites_get
tools.description: Search Console: list all properties for the user.
tools.behavior: GETs Search Console properties accessible to the OAuth user.

tools.name: gsc_site_get
tools.description: Search Console: get one property and the user's permission level.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: GETs one Search Console property and permission information with encoded site URL.

tools.name: gsc_site_add
tools.description: Search Console: add (claim) a property.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: PUTs a Search Console property URL to add it to the account; performs no ownership verification flow.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: gsc_site_delete
tools.description: Search Console: remove a property from the account.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: DELETEs a Search Console property from the account.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: gsc_sitemaps_get
tools.description: Search Console: list submitted sitemaps for a property.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: GETs submitted sitemaps for an encoded Search Console site URL.

tools.name: gsc_sitemap_get
tools.description: Search Console: get status of one sitemap.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: GETs sitemap status using encoded site URL and sitemap URL.

tools.name: gsc_sitemap_submit
tools.description: Search Console: submit a sitemap.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: PUTs a sitemap URL to Search Console.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: gsc_sitemap_delete
tools.description: Search Console: delete a sitemap.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: DELETEs a sitemap submission from Search Console.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Search Console: query search performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) by dimensions over a date range.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: POSTs Search Console date range and supplied dimensions, row limit, search type and start row; omitted row_limit is not explicitly defaulted by handler.

tools.name: gsc_url_inspect
tools.description: Search Console: inspect a URL's index status, coverage, mobile usability, and rich results.

site_url.description: Property URL exactly as in Search Console, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: POSTs URL inspection request with site URL and optional language code.

tools.name: idx_url_submit
tools.description: Indexing API: notify Google that a URL was added/updated (URL_UPDATED).
tools.behavior: POSTs a URL_UPDATED notification to Google Indexing API.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: idx_url_delete
tools.description: Indexing API: notify Google that a URL was removed (URL_DELETED).
tools.behavior: POSTs a URL_DELETED notification to Google Indexing API.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: idx_metadata
tools.description: Indexing API: get the latest notification metadata for a URL.
tools.behavior: GETs latest Indexing API notification metadata for a URL.

tools.name: ga4_accounts_get
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list Analytics accounts the user can access.
tools.behavior: Lists GA4 Analytics Admin accounts through GET /v1beta/accounts; returns a single page.

tools.name: ga4_properties_get
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list properties under an account.
tools.behavior: Lists GA4 properties with parent account filter; accepts numeric account ID or accounts/ prefix.

tools.name: ga4_property_get
tools.description: GA4 Admin: get a property.
tools.behavior: GETs a GA4 property after stripping an optional properties/ prefix.

tools.name: ga4_property_create
tools.description: GA4 Admin: create a new GA4 property under an account.
tools.behavior: Creates a GA4 property under an account with timezone and currency defaulting to USD.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: ga4_datastreams_get
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list data streams of a property.
tools.behavior: Lists GA4 data streams for a property; returns a single page.

tools.name: ga4_datastream_create
tools.description: GA4 Admin: create a WEB data stream (returns the Measurement ID / tag — i.e. installs the GA4 counter).
tools.behavior: Creates a GA4 WEB_DATA_STREAM with display name and default URI; creation does not install site code.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: ga4_datastream_get
tools.description: GA4 Admin: get a data stream (includes measurement ID).
tools.behavior: GETs a GA4 data stream using property and stream IDs.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: GA4 Data: run a report (metrics + dimensions over a date range).
tools.behavior: POSTs a GA4 Data runReport with date range, metrics, optional dimensions and limit.

tools.name: ga4_realtime
tools.description: GA4 Data: run a realtime report.
tools.behavior: POSTs a GA4 Data runRealtimeReport with metrics and optional dimensions.

tools.name: gtm_accounts_get
tools.description: Tag Manager: list GTM accounts.
tools.behavior: GETs Tag Manager v2 accounts; does not paginate.

tools.name: gtm_containers_get
tools.description: Tag Manager: list containers under an account.
tools.behavior: GETs containers under the supplied GTM account; does not paginate.

tools.name: gtm_container_create
tools.description: Tag Manager: create a container (returns its GTM-ID).
tools.behavior: POSTs name and usageContext to GTM containers, defaulting usageContext to [web].
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: gtm_workspaces_get
tools.description: Tag Manager: list workspaces of a container.
tools.behavior: GETs workspaces under the supplied GTM container; does not paginate.

tools.name: gtm_tags_get
tools.description: Tag Manager: list tags in a workspace.
tools.behavior: GETs tags under the supplied GTM workspace; does not paginate.

tools.name: gtm_tag_create
tools.description: Tag Manager: create a tag in a workspace. Pass the raw GTM tag object (type + parameters).
tools.behavior: POSTs the unrestricted raw tag object to the supplied GTM workspace tags endpoint.
tools.exposure: G_READONLY=true denies execution; G_CONFIRM=true adds properties.confirm={type:"boolean",description:"Must be true to execute this mutating call (G_CONFIRM is enabled)."} with no required entry.

tools.name: psi_run
tools.description: PageSpeed Insights: analyze a URL (Core Web Vitals + Lighthouse). No OAuth needed; uses GOOGLE_PSI_API_KEY if set.
tools.behavior: Calls PageSpeed Insights with strategy defaulting to mobile, optional categories/locale and environment API key; OAuth is disabled.

review.summary: Browse GTM accounts and workspaces, create containers, and create tags from raw resource objects.
